# Lists

A list is a set of things to buy: "Weekend", "Big shop", "Party". You can
have as many lists as you like.

## Your lists page

**Your lists** shows every list you own, with how many items on each are
still to buy ("3 to buy"). Below them, **Shared with me** shows the lists
other people have shared with you, with the name of the person who shared
each one ("from Ann").

Press **Pantry** at the top of any page to come back here.

## Making a list

Type a name under **New list** and press **Create list**. Names can be up to
80 characters long. Pantry opens the list straight away so you can start
adding items.

## Renaming a list

Open the list, and under **Manage** change the name in **Rename list**, then
press **Rename**. Only the person who owns a list can rename it.

## Deleting a list

Open the list and press **Delete list** under **Manage**. The list and
everything on it are gone for good — for you and for everyone you shared it
with — so be sure before you press it. Only the person who owns a list can
delete it.

## Lists shared with you

A list someone shares with you works almost like your own: you can add items,
mark them bought and delete them. You can't rename it, delete it or share it
with anyone else — those are up to the person who owns it. The list says who
that is ("Shared with you by Ann").
